title: Division of the kingdom of Israel
summary: After Solomon's death the kingdom splits into the northern kingdom of Israel and the southern kingdom of Judah (1 Kings 12).
description: Added from the Morecraft import (Morecraft, A Christian Survey of World History). Jones, Appendix F (23rd ed., 2026), sets the sort. Morecraft stays on display.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (Floyd Nolen Jones): 975 BC (no higher-tier year available).

chronologies.date: 3029 975 Secession under Jeroboam I of Israel
chronologies.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 23rd ed. (Master Books, 2026), Appendix F, printed p. 279 (PDF p. 314)
chronologies.note: This record is the split of the kingdom (1 Kgs 12). Jones's secession line is that event. "Rehoboam becomes king over Judah" is a separate line in the same year and does not set this sort.
